title: [docs] Searching in docs does not jump to correct place in page
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
When on https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/, If I search (eg. `label`), and click on the result or select it through the keyboard, nothing happens. I'm not redirected to the correct part of the doc.

![2017-05-16\_11h26m07](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/26099246/7dd6500e-3a2a-11e7-9551-69f716261cac.gif)

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**
I would expect the page to jump to the selected part of the page/

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**
Tested on Chrome Version 57.0.2987.133 (64-bit) on Ubuntu

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**
Selecting a result should jump to the correct part. Maybe it's time to use DocSearch on this website?
